summary: Tests-only (red-phase) run for issue #39. All deliverable tests are committed at HEAD 22d2b9e and lint (bin/lint) passes. Two tests fail red by design, demonstrating the missing deliverables: the upstream parity corpus (viamin/color_matching#111) is not committed (SolverParityCorpusTests.testUpstreamParityCorpusIsCommitted) and the OpenAPI document (viamin/color_matching#110) is not committed (OpenAPIContractTests.testOpenAPIDocumentIsCommitted). Both upstream PRs do not exist yet (GitHub API returns no such PRs). No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so swift test could not be executed locally; seed-corpus expectations were independently recomputed and verified with a Python model of the scorer's exact arithmetic (all 8 cases match, scores within 1e-9). Implementation (swift-openapi-generator adoption, corpus/spec commit, README update) belongs to the follow-up implementation run after paid-tests-approved.
